items.summary: Newly acquired Hornets forward Naz Reid was benched at halftime of Wednesday's loss to the Pistons for not meeting the team's standards.
items.headline: Hornets bench Naz Reid at half for not meeting 'our standards'

items.summary: The Lakers played the Clippers on Wednesday night without Luka Doncic; the story gives no reason.
items.headline: Lakers rout Clippers 103-87 without Luka Doncic
